messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming.sse.request_latencies.p99 > 2.5s in eu-west-1 for 3m. Auto-page sent to oncall group.
Anna (SRE): I can see p95 ~ 760ms, p99 ~ 3.2s, plus a spike of stalled chunk delivery on /v1/stream endpoints. 502s from edge-proxy-2 and a backlog metric (sse_outstanding_bytes) trending up.
Jordan (Oncall): I'm on it, taking pager. Starting triage now. @Mike please join — looks like an edge/backpressure interaction.
Mike (Eng Runtime): joining. Quick checks: 1) proxy worker queue depth high on edge-proxy-2 2) several client connections in CLOSE_WAIT with no bytes forwarded 3) upstream read timeout events increased.
Anna (SRE): Prom query I pushed: `sum(rate(streaming_chunk_delay_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,region)` shows a right-shift in eu-west-1 buckets. Also `sse_workers_active{instance="sse-workers-3"}` at 95% of capacity.
Jordan (Oncall): Running kubectl to inspect the proxy pod logs now:
```
kubectl -n edge logs deploy/edge-proxy-2 --since=10m | grep -E "upstream_timeout|write_timeout|stalled chunk"
```
Mike (Eng Runtime): Logs show repeating `upstream read timeout after 30s` and `write failed: connection reset by peer` from clients sending slow ACKs. Looks like a classic slow-consumer backpressure scenario combined with proxy write blocking.
Luke (Support): getting customer reports of "stream stalls" and partial responses for a handful of high-throughput customers in EU region. Ticket IDs: #12345, #12378. Customer impact: degraded streaming (some clients drop and reconnect), non-streaming API unaffected.
Anna (SRE): Quick mitigation plan proposal: 1) increase proxy `upstream_read_timeout` from 30s -> 60s temporarily to avoid spurious upstream aborts 2) enable streaming chunk trimming (reduce max chunk window) on edge-proxy-2 3) re-route a fraction of traffic to eu-central-1 to relieve load 4) enable aggressive client backpressure kill (disconnect clients with >90s stall). Thoughts?
Mike (Eng Runtime): +1 for routing spill. But increasing `upstream_read_timeout` may hide true slow consumers and increase memory pressure. Prefer: a) reduce max outstanding bytes per connection to 64KB b) enable send buffer shedding c) route 25% traffic to eu-central-1. I'll prepare the proxy config patch.
Jordan (Oncall): I'll execute the routing change via trafficrouter runbook `rt-route-spill` and coordinate with infra to scale sse-workers by +2 replicas in EU. Doing routing now.
IncidentBot: :information_source: ACTION: trafficrouter:spill set eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 (25%).
Anna (SRE): Scaling sse-workers: `kubectl -n streaming scale deployment sse-workers --replicas=6` (was 4). Scaling triggered.
Mike (Eng Runtime): Pushing small proxy config patch to limit per-conn outstanding bytes and lower chunk window:
```
# proxy.conf snippet
upstream_read_timeout 30s;
proxy_stream_max_outstanding_bytes 65536;
streaming_chunk_window 16k;
```
Mike (Eng Runtime): Rolling edge-proxy-2 canary with the patch now (1 pod at a time).
Jordan (Oncall): Canaries look OK so far, tail latencies in eu-west-1 p99 dropped from 3.2s -> 1.1s over last 90s. p95 stable ~600-800ms.
Luke (Support): Updated customers: sent note to affected accounts, included recommended client-side timeouts and reconnect logic. No SLA escalations yet.
Sara (Product): noted for status page update. I'll mark as "degraded streaming - mitigation in progress".
Anna (SRE): Observed proxy file descriptors spike earlier; after the patch FD usage stabilized. Outstanding bytes per-connection metric decreased from ~220KB median to ~48KB median.
Jordan (Oncall): All mitigation steps executed: routing spill, worker scale, proxy patch canary -> rollout complete. Will monitor for 30m.
Mike (Eng Runtime): Follow-up items captured: 1) add per-client pending-bytes alert 2) tune default client SDK backoff docs 3) consider short-term autoscale policy change for sse-workers by traffic percentile.
Jordan (Oncall): Marking pager resolved for now. Will keep the incident channel open for the 30m watch.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: PAGE RESOLVED: oncall acknowledged, mitigations applied.
Luke (Support): Closing customer-facing tickets as "mitigation in place"; will reopen if we see regressions.
Anna (SRE): Postmortem notes to follow — initial root: slow-consumer spike + proxy chunk-window configuration too permissive. Proposed remediation: default per-conn outstanding bytes limit, improved SDK guidance, and more aggressive scaling thresholds.
Mike (Eng Runtime): Adding one more concrete metric request: `sum(stream_pending_bytes) by (client_app,region)` to help identify heavy consumers.
Jordan (Oncall): Last check: p99 at 1.0s, p95 at 580ms, sse_worker CPU and queues normalizing. Closing incident at 4876543320.
Sara (Product): Thanks team. I'll coordinate postmortem and customer comms summary.
